name: TechPluto

sources.title: Submit startup page — exists in nav but renders 'Loading…' (JS form)
Advertise page — invites tips on 'disruptive startups, innovative products' via email
TechPluto homepage — startup and tech news publication

requirements: Editorial startup/tech news site — coverage is a news feature, not a self-serve directory listing
Advertise page invites tips on 'disruptive startups, innovative products' by email
preparation: A concise pitch: what the startup does, why it is newsworthy, founder/company details, URL
Contact email is published on the advertise page (Cloudflare-obfuscated) — retrieve it via the contact page in a browser
workflow: Try https://www.techpluto.com/submit-startup/ in a JavaScript-capable browser — the form body loads client-side ('Loading…' to plain fetchers)
Alternatively, email a startup tip via the address given on /advertise/ or the contact form at /contact-us/
If accepted, TechPluto publishes a feature/review-style post (examples: 'Featured Startups' category)
watchFor: The batch-supplied submission URL /submit-tool/ returns 404; the correct slug is /submit-startup/
Site is ad-heavy WordPress; paid advertising is separate from editorial submission — do not confuse an ad buy with coverage
No published price for a submission; the JS form's fields could not be inspected
countsAsLive: A post profiling the startup is published on techpluto.com (typically under Featured Startups or Startup categories)
unknowns: Whether submitting via /submit-startup/ is free or leads to a paid offer
The JS form's fields and review turnaround
